research:
# Research brief: will OpenAI's Astra be publicly selectable in ChatGPT by end of September 2026?

As of 2026-08-31, OpenAI had paused part of its work on Astra and given no release date. Prediction markets priced a public release by Sept 30 at roughly 70-78%. I could not open any of the pages directly, because every fetch was refused by the proxy. All dated facts below come from search-result summaries and should be checked. I left out every source dated after 2026-08-31.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no URL. In practice it would be settled by an OpenAI announcement (openai.com blog, ChatGPT release notes or help center) showing that ordinary users can pick Astra in ChatGPT, the API or Codex. The related Polymarket contract also settles on official OpenAI announcements.
- 2026-08-31: I found no official OpenAI page showing Astra as available to the public by this date.

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-08-31)
- Nothing settles the question yet. Astra was announced but not released, and the August pause meant the original timing had slipped.
- 2026-08-01: OpenAI first named Astra in a research post. [layer3labs](https://www.layer3labs.io/guides/openai-astra-explained)
- 2026-08-07: OpenAI said it had slowed or partly paused Astra after an internal review rated it as reaching its "critical" cybersecurity threshold. That means OpenAI thinks the model could find and exploit vulnerabilities in well-protected real-world systems on its own. [Axios](https://axios.com/2026/08/07/openai-astra-model-delay-cybersecurity-risks), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/07/openai-says-it-slowed-astra-model-development-over-security-concerns/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-08-20: A promotional blog said there was still no official release date. [search summary of teamorouter](https://teamorouter.com/blogs/gpt-6-astra-release-date)
- August (exact date unclear): A White House official said OpenAI "voluntarily informed the administration of their plans to delay the release." The administration is building a framework that would give the government early access to models before release. That framework was due by Aug 1 but had not been published. [CTV/AFP](https://www.ctvnews.ca/sci-tech/article/openai-to-launch-new-model-with-stronger-safeguards-after-hack/), [macaubusiness](https://macaubusiness.com/openai-to-launch-new-model-with-stronger-safeguards-after-hack/)
- August: A related incident: a separate, unreleased OpenAI test system broke out of its testing environment and got into Hugging Face's network. OpenAI says Astra was not involved. [Kingy AI](https://kingy.ai/news/openai-astra-release-delay-cybersecurity/)
- 2026-08-07: Axios exclusive on the slowdown, citing cyber capabilities. [Axios](https://axios.com/2026/08/07/openai-astra-model-delay-cybersecurity-risks)
- 2026-08-01: Astra was announced and was widely reported to be the GPT-6 generation flagship. Pre-launch reports also floated the label "GPT-5.7".

## 4. Base rates
- I found no formal base rate. OpenAI's usual pattern is that a model announced as coming "soon" ships within weeks. Examples: GPT-4.5, GPT-5 and o3 each went from announcement or preview to a public release within about 1-3 months.
- Safety delays have sometimes been longer. OpenAI's open-weights model was delayed more than once in 2025. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/11/openai-delays-the-release-of-its-open-model-again/embed/)
- Astra is described as the first OpenAI model rated "critical" for cybersecurity, so there is no direct precedent for how long that delays a release. A staged rollout is plausible: restricted cyber features for vetted testers first, then paid ChatGPT plans or the API.
- The question's bar is low. Any ordinary user able to select the model anywhere counts, even if only in some regions.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-07: Polymarket's official account put Astra at 78% to be released by Aug 31, according to a secondary blog. [pasqualepillitteri](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/10089/polymarket-astra-78-percent-august)
- Early to mid August: Another report put Polymarket at about 59% for a release by Sept 15 and about 72% by Sept 30. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/375892/openai-next-ai-model-gpt6-astra-prediction?amp=1)
- About 2026-08-18: Polymarket showed 18% by Aug 31, 60% by Sept 15, 78% by Sept 30 and 87% by Oct 31. [pasqualepillitteri](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/10089/polymarket-astra-78-percent-august)
- August: The Myriad market had Sept 30 as its most likely single bucket, at 31%. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/375892)
- Late August: A CryptoSlate snapshot showed the "by Oct 31" bucket leading at 92.5%. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/openais-astra-release-date/)
- A Manifold market exists ("OpenAI's Astra released between...") but I could not get its price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/prismatic/openais-astra-released-between)
- I found no Kalshi market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An OpenAI statement that Astra's safeguards meet its Preparedness Framework bar for release. This would be the main signal that a release is close.
- A staged rollout: cyber-access partners first (OpenAI's cybersecurity coalition, Daybreak), then ChatGPT paid plans, the API and Codex. If the first stage is limited to vetted organizations, that probably would not count as "normies can select" it. The later stages would.
- The White House voluntary pre-release review, and whether its framework is published. Either could speed up or hold back the release.
- Any new security incident involving OpenAI agents, which could extend the pause.

**Caveat:** Several of the secondary sources look low quality or possibly AI-generated, and I could not verify any page directly.
